reuse.why: The flag is threaded cleanly through the single linkBankSyncAccount definition, but releasing the old account re-writes the local-unlink field reset instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount into a shared helper.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one inside unlinkAccount, so the meaning of 'unlinked' now lives in two places.

placement.why: The takeover logic sits in the shared linkBankSyncAccount where the existing-link refusal already lives; provider wrappers only forward the flag.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the takeover in the shared link function, and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable, but if unlinkAccount's reset gains a field the takeover path silently diverges; a small clearLocalLink helper used by both would be expected.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount: resets the holder account with its own db.updateAccount copy instead of a shared local-unlink step from unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: the copied unlink field reset is a literal copy, not disguised
